independent_audit.latest_scope: H5 exact registered aggregate algorithmic-work claim

gate_changes_reviewed.change: Funnel Correction v2 adds MECHANISM/SYSTEM claim ceilings, preformal eligibility, HOLD subtypes, portfolio split, mechanism-priority allocation, one-in-three theory-backward SUB supply, and machine-readable PRE_FORMAL readiness without a universal numeric threshold
gate_changes_reviewed.justification_trace: Recent lower-funnel autonomous SUB selections are SYSTEM/API/engineering heavy while PRE_FORMAL has no surviving mechanism object

gate_changes_reviewed.change: Current durable Evidence Analyst and MAIN candidate records do not yet persist the mandatory Funnel v2 fields or funnel_metrics
Current Assembly static Architecture study preserves a SYSTEM resource/reachability question without manufacturing a dynamic comparator, saturation failure, or novelty claim

false_positive_risks: MECHANISM labels could be strategically assigned to quota-fill SYSTEM/API questions unless claim_ceiling is prospectively justified and auditable
preformal_eligible could be set too early from mechanism-sounding language rather than a coherent claim-local mechanism question
READY could become a hidden success criterion if reductions/comparator/falsifier are interpreted as already won rather than prospectively specified and development-ready
SYSTEM-over-MECHANISM priority exceptions could become unbounded unless the reason is machine-readable
raw funnel conversion rates could be mistaken for scientific thresholds despite v2 explicitly rejecting a universal numeric readiness threshold
false_negative_risks: A rigid SYSTEM label could block a legitimate later mechanism question if fresh SYSTEM-to-MECHANISM successor creation is not explicitly allowed
SYSTEM research could be suppressed if mechanism priority is treated as absolute rather than preserving testbed/evidence/reachability/reproducibility/Formal-integrity exceptions
preformal_eligible and READY could become duplicate guards and make PRE_FORMAL practically unreachable
readiness comparator requirements could overmatch the mechanism and remove the target phenomenon
the one-in-three quota could manufacture low-quality mechanism questions if NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET is not an explicit auditable exception

pairs.finding: Do not merge if semantics are distinct: claim type, in-principle PF eligibility, and current development readiness. If eligibility is only set at READY they become redundant.

duplicate_guards.other_guards: provenance, machine-fact validity, handoff fidelity and fresh Analyst review remain distinct and should not be merged

moving_goalpost_assessment.basis: Funnel v2 is audited prospectively as a supply/observability correction. No consumed/frozen historical object is to be rescored, upgraded, invalidated or relabeled solely because of v2.

required_path: coherent theory/native mechanism signal or question
preformal_eligible=true once a genuine mechanism claim is coherent
one-way FORMAL integrity chain and preserved evidence
pass_reachability_assessment.circularity_warning: READY must not require already surviving the comparator/falsifier/reduction outcome that PRE_FORMAL or FORMAL is intended to test.
pass_reachability_assessment.historical_formal_machinery_evidence: H5 demonstrates the one-way Formal execution/preserve/evidence chain is operational, but is not retroactively relabeled under v2.

claim_type_separation_findings.mechanism_transition_rule: A SYSTEM object may motivate a fresh independently prospective MECHANISM successor; the consumed SYSTEM object itself must not be upgraded post-outcome.

mechanism_supply_health.risk: API/config/reproducibility throughput can starve central-theory mechanism supply even while producing legitimate SYSTEM value.

funnel_observability.recommendation: Persist mandatory v2 fields prospectively before using funnel_metrics or conversion rates to judge policy. Do not cosmetically backfill consumed history.

healthy_interpretation.support: claim-local adequacy to justify the next test, not universal numeric support
healthy_interpretation.reductions: ordinary alternatives specified/controlled enough for an informative test, not conclusively defeated already
healthy_interpretation.comparator: claim-local matched comparator where the claim requires one
healthy_interpretation.reachability: supported possibility appropriate to the claim, not prevalence unless prevalence is claimed
healthy_interpretation.open_choice_accounting: outcome-responsive degrees of freedom closed or explicitly bounded

external_calibration.finding: No current external result justifies a universal numeric readiness threshold or a stricter global admission bar. External work supports claim-local ordinary reductions and narrow claim boundaries.

opportunity_cost.system_value_protection: SYSTEM priority exceptions are necessary because some system work protects testbed validity, evidence interpretation, supported reachability, reproducibility or Formal integrity.

prospective_recommendations: Persist claim_ceiling, preformal_eligible, HOLD subtype, readiness status and funnel_metrics prospectively in Evidence Analyst candidate records and successor handoffs before using funnel conversion as policy evidence.
Define claim_ceiling as a current-object ceiling; allow SYSTEM-to-MECHANISM only via a fresh independently motivated prospective successor.
Keep the required HOLD primary subtype but also record orthogonal hold_reason, terminal/nonterminal and queue/active fields.
Require a machine-readable exception reason whenever MAIN selects SYSTEM over a comparably executable/informative MECHANISM candidate.

Apply the one-in-three SUB rule only to safe nonduplicative autonomous selections; require a coherent falsifiable theory-backward mechanism question and allow an explicit NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET exception.
Treat readiness as development readiness, not evidence that the candidate has already won its comparator, reductions or falsifier.
Do not add a programme-wide universal numeric readiness/support threshold.
Preserve SYSTEM Architecture/testbed/reproducibility value and integrity exceptions under mechanism priority.
Keep all v2 changes prospective; do not backfill/rescore consumed historical results for cosmetic completeness.
utility_request_reason: No bounded synthetic Utility check currently has higher information gain than observing the first live v2 allocations, rolling SUB window and first READY-to-PRE_FORMAL transition.
questions_for_control_brain: Will SYSTEM-over-MECHANISM priority exceptions be persisted machine-readably so allocation cannot be strategically justified after the fact?
Will SYSTEM-to-MECHANISM movement require a fresh prospective successor rather than mutating a consumed SYSTEM object's claim ceiling?
How will NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET be represented when the rolling SUB theory-backward slot has no scientifically coherent target?
questions_for_evidence_analyst: Will preformal_eligible represent in-principle MECHANISM eligibility separately from current readiness_status=READY?
Will HOLD subtype be supplemented by orthogonal hold reason and queue/terminal fields to avoid losing information?
Will funnel_metrics report completeness and missing-v2-field counts so conversion rates cannot be interpreted from partially classified populations?
Will READY mean development readiness rather than already passing the comparator/reduction/falsifier?
